text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a sidewalk boulevard vending permit located at 2575 Danforth Avenue, 16.50 metres east of Main Street on the south side of Danforth Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its January 8, 2020 meeting.
